paragraphs: It is Sunday morning, and Lily and Dad make pancakes. "Today we cook breakfast," says Dad. He goes shopping for flour, eggs, and milk. Tom says, "I do not like to cook. It is boring." "Come on, Tom!" says Lily. "It is fun." Tom comes to the kitchen and helps. Dad has a big blue bowl and a pan. Lily reads the steps in Grandma's old book. Pip waits next to the table.

Step one: put the flour in a big bowl. Step two: add two eggs. Step three: mix the flour and the milk slowly. Tom mixes quickly, and the flour goes on the floor. "Slowly, Tom!" says Dad. He asks Tom to clean the floor. Step four: put the mix in the pan carefully. The pan is hot and dangerous, so Lily stands back. "Do not put your hand in it," says Dad. Dad cooks the pancake until it is yellow.

Step five: turn the pancake and cook it again. Tom puts salt on his pancake, not sugar. "Is there a difference?" asks Lily. Tom eats the pancake and says, "Yuck!" "This pancake is not good." Dad laughs and says, "Nothing is wrong with the pan." "We try again, and now we read the steps." Dad makes a new pancake, and it is yellow and round. Tom eats three pancakes! Step six: add sugar and say, "Well done!" Do you like pancakes with sugar? Lily gives Pip a small bit, and he says, "Woof!"
